name: Kura Shizuku
description: A quiet-luxury theme for small sake breweries and tasting rooms that sell bottles, gift sets and brewery goods online. Every page is composed like a sake bottle label: centred and symmetric, framed by fine double gilt hairlines, with a single drop as the recurring mark, small spaced capitals and a lot of calm space. Rice-polish ivory, koji beige, aged cedar brown, sake-lees grey and a restrained gilded gold, EB Garamond with a gold italic for titles and Albert Sans for text, slow drip-and-ripple reveals that stop under reduced motion. Includes a brewery page with the process, the brewing year and tours, a tasting room page with flights and booking information, a newsletter and contact page with a map, a responsible-drinking note in the footer, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
